headline: Sailor Ren climbs from 930th to 60th on ARC-3

sections.text: Sailor Ren gained 5.67 to reach 35.09, moving from 930th to 60th on the ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard in the past day. The advance brings the team into the top 100; the provisional gold cutoff stands at 38.22.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
